name: Rüschegg (Switzerland)
description: Square banner of the arms of Rüschegg: on yellow a black lion's paw issuing from the upper fly holding a green fir with a red trunk set diagonally.
history: Swiss municipal flags are square banners of the municipal arms, used alongside the arms without a separate adoption act.

features.role: lion's paw from the upper fly
fir with red trunk set diagonally
